comments: Input facts: ego is a car initiator; agent1 is a responder with allowed type car or pedestrian; the backing group requires at least one reversing road user. Chosen assumptions: agent1 approaches from 17-21 m behind at 3-4 m/s and changes to the clear same-direction left lane when within 14-16 m of ego. Ego waits 0.6-0.9 s, reverses with throttle 0.25-0.35 for 3-4 s, then brakes; the follower evades the reversing initiator. Distances are center-to-center, speeds are m/s, and times are seconds. Outcome intent is a conflict opportunity, without requiring collision.
